name: Cali Blaze | 1.2g Donut Blunt | Cotton Candy
description:
Sugar-spun sweetness with a floral undertone. The sativa genetics keep things light and social — this is a party strain that happens to taste like the county fair. Burns slow, tastes sweet, doesn't knock you out.
Key terpenes: Limonene, Caryophyllene, Humulene

The 1.2g Live Resin Donut. A kief-coated donut blunt with a premium glass tip, wrapped in natural hemp. Infused with live resin and rolled in kief. Available in all 24 signature flavors.

* Glass tip: Smooth, clean draw every time.
* Live resin infused: Full-spectrum concentrate injected into premium flower.
* Hemp Wrap: Natural hemp for a slow, even burn.
